function.description: Pin an ERC-20 token on a LOCAL chain (e.g. Robinhood 4663) so `wallet_balances` and the portfolio track it. Local chains scan a fixed set (seed tokens + pins); pin any token received by transfer or airdrop — swap and bridge executes auto-pin theirs. DB-only bookmark: no on-chain transaction. Khalani-covered chains do not need pinning.
function.name: wallet_track_token

action.description: pin adds a token to tracking, unpin removes it, list shows the chain's seed + pinned set.

token.description: ERC-20 contract ADDRESS (0x…). Required for pin/unpin; ignored for list. Resolve a symbol to its address first.
